series: JLPT N3 grammar series; denominator = 220 Bunpro N3 entries (n3-coverage-matrix, frozen)
levelPolicy: Bunpro precedence (docs/jlpt-levels.md); Rule A owning level kept for reused items; new items classified by the complete visible contrast; Rule B both Sensei and SKM at N3; Rule C N2 only where the exact sense is supported at N2 and N3 placement cannot be verified.

primarySources.use: N3 ではなくて／じゃなくて 'not A but B': A is not correct, B is; Noun／na-adjective + ではなく(て), verb／い-adjective + のではなく(て); なく is the written form.
N3 というより 'more B than A': A is re-evaluated and B is the closer description; follows any word, Noun／na-adjective with optional だ.
N3 むしろ 'rather': a more accurate description or preferred choice, often with Aより; 寧ろ as rare kanji.
N3 却って 'on the contrary': (A) is the intention or aim and (B) the result instead; examples with 手伝い／邪魔 and 「やれ」と言われると.
N3 一方で 'while, on the other hand, at the same time': attributive form + 一方(で), な／である after na-adjectives, sentence-initial (その)一方で; distinguished from 一方だ.
N3 もっとも (尤も) 'although, with that said': clarifies that (A) is not the whole picture; (B) often ends with が／けど.
N3 代わりに 'instead of, in place of, in exchange for': attributive form + 代わりに; 替わり noted as a variant.
N4 それに 'besides, moreover': adds information pointing the same way as (A) (all positive or all negative). Used as the contrast side for もっとも.

supplementarySources.supports: かえって = a result opposite to expectation; むしろ = a choice after comparing two, often with Aより; seen through a search snippet only, not fetched.
Row statuses and existing 代わりに exercise IDs (row 215).

dispositions.note: Interpretation items (printed というより／っていうより, label 言い換え) against ではなくて (label 否定): clear rewording of one thing (寒いというより痛い type, teacher/friend, lively/noisy, hobby/job). っていうより／って言うより noted as casual forms in the article.
Interpretation items (printed むしろ, label 比較) against かえって (label 逆): より comparisons (noun, verb + たい), 〜くらいなら, Aではなく、むしろB and Aというより、むしろB.

Interpretation items (printed かえって, label 逆) against むしろ (label 比較), converted from cloze after reviewers disagreed on むしろ in backfire sentences. One state item (大きすぎる部屋) and four intention/outcome items.

dispositions.entry: ではなくて-じゃなくて
dispositions.note: NEWL light entry (4 interpretation items, label 否定) against というより: plain factual corrections (owner, sugar/salt, exit, wrong order) printing ではなくて／じゃなくて／ではなく. The time-linking ではなくても items are a different construction.

Sentence-initial reservation against それに (Bunpro N4; two contrast-side targets, jlpt 3 because the well-formed もっとも option is N3). Two of four もっとも items end without が／けれど so the ending is not a cue. 最も 'most' is a different word and not accepted.

Clause-final 一方で against 代わりに: two people, simultaneous activities, a trend with complaints, one person in two settings. Contexts avoid trade-offs, where 代わりに could also fit. 一方だ (change-phase-trends) is a different construction.

Covered elsewhere (Noun + のかわり with に printed). Three new verb-clause items are the contrast side for 一方で (two substitutions, one exchange). The brief's に代わって option was not used: comparison-role-relations owns that row and the validator would require it as a target here.

groups.reason: Correcting a description extends the contrast material in reasons-contrasts-and-listing.
むしろ and かえって are contrast adverbs measured against an expectation or alternative.
一方で and 代わりに contrast or replace clauses; かわりに already sits in this area.
Sentence connectives that limit or add extend しかし／それに in reasons-and-contrasts.

vocabulary.policy: Local displayed-form readings/glosses; no canonical word references; blank protected as grammar-target.

reviewLimits: No physical-device rendering check was performed.
Model-authored; independent model reviews recorded by the coordinator.

independentReview.method: Three blind single-facet reviews, each by a fresh agent with a different requested model family, given only the frozen render, raw set JSON, article and ledger: A linguistic correctness, B consistency and quiz safety, C learner comprehensibility. Findings were consolidated by the coordinator, applied by the author, and sent back to the original reviewers for a per-finding disposition.
independentReview.actualModelNote: The runtime does not expose the served model; the requested model is recorded.

findings.claim: A precedence rule ('use かえって rather than むしろ') keyed cloze items where むしろ was also defensible.
findings.change: All 10 items became interpretation items: the sentence prints むしろ or かえって, and the learner picks the function label.

findings.claim: A rhetorical ではなくて was defensible in というより cloze items (teacher-friend, party-noisy, garden-hobby).
findings.change: All 8 items became interpretation items with the labels 否定 and 言い換え.

findings.claim: The 'A is partly right' account of というより was inaccurate.
findings.change: §1 describes というより as a reformulation (B is the better wording); the rationales no longer rely on A being asserted.

findings.claim: っていうより was accepted but って言うより was not.
findings.change: というより is no longer a typed answer; party-noisy prints っていうより; the formation notes list both spellings.

findings.claim: かえって was defined only as an action's reversed effect.
findings.change: §2 covers an outcome or state contrary to expectation; added the state item kaette-big-room; removed kaette-study-nagging.

findings.claim: Typed spellings 言換え, 言い替え and 言替え were rejected.
findings.change: Accepted as typed answers; the option label stays 言い換え.

findings.claim: Distractor rationales relied on a task rule rather than on meaning.
The 否定 definition also fitted というより, so the labels were not decidable.
findings.change: 否定 = 'A and B are different things; A is wrong and B is right'; 言い換え = 'the same thing, where B is the better wording'.

findings.claim: The explanation claimed というより belongs to casual speech.
findings.change: Now 'っていうより is the casual form of というより; it can follow a な-adjective directly'.

findings.claim: 〜うと思って omitted the よ of the volitional.
高い代わりに質がいい had no reading.
